description: Open deals and freebies. Use this when the user wants free games, giveaways, free credits or limited-time deals, such as "any free Steam games right now?" or "free VPS offers". Pass query (words that must all appear, such as steam, dlc or vps; leave it out for every open deal) and optionally sources and limit. Returns open deals from GamerPower, V2EX, NodeSeek, newest first, each with its link, kind, publish time and free_until when the source gives an end date. Deals are deleted 30 days after they were published. Game giveaways data by GamerPower.com (https://www.gamerpower.com).

query.description: Words that must all appear in a deal's title or kind, such as "steam", "vps" or "dlc". Leave it out for every open deal.

sources.description: Read only these deal sources (default: all)

name: trending_deals

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

free_until.description: When the offer ends; null when the source gives no end date

kind.description: What is on offer as the source names it (game, dlc, early access); null for a forum post

url.description: The deal's page on its source

retention_days.description: Deals are deleted this many days after they were published

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Open deals and freebies
